compounds.label: ROFLUMILAST
compounds.notes: Wang 2025 JID comparison set: 0.7 nM; Hatzelmann & Schudt 2001: 0.8 nM. Re-dock control on its own structure 3G4L.

compounds.label: APREMILAST
compounds.notes: Wang 2025 JID comparison set: 0.14 uM. Schafer 2010 measured 74 nM -- range 74-140 nM; ranking unaffected.

compounds.label: CILOMILAST
compounds.notes: Hatzelmann & Schudt 2001: 120 nM (human PDE4). Card et al.: PDE4D 11 nM, PDE4B 25 nM -- subtype-dependent; range 11-120 nM; ranking unaffected.

crisaborole_reference: NOT docked: benzoxaborole, contains boron; Vina PDBQT parser rejects atom type B (proven by the pipeline run on HP-064 taniborbactam). Measured reference only: 0.24 uM (Wang 2025 JID abstract); 0.75 uM in the same paper's text and in J Clin Aesthet Dermatol 2025;18(7):18-21. Either value leaves it last by a wide margin.
correction_note: Pipeline run dock-HP-077-2026-11-15.json is DISCARDED (UniProt Q86H13 Dictyostelium PDE; ChEMBL CHEMBL2074 maltase-glucoamylase; no_pdb_found). This file is the corrected docking on 3G4L (human PDE4D + roflumilast).
